page.layout: One text page, single column of dictionary entries with Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee words; running head at top; page number at top right; no margin notes beyond a few marks.

main_text.p: nis. Plur.emph. מֵעֲרְעָא Psalm.74.8. const. מֵעֲרְעֵי, Levit.23.2.3.
עַרְפִילָא Ch. עַרְפָּלָן Syr. Caligo, obscuritas. Affine est Græc. ὀρφνη, quod idem; L, & N enim sunt permutabiles.
עַרְפְּרָא Ch. Vespertilio, Deuteron.14.18. in Jon. Hebr. עַטְלֵף. Targ. Hierof. הַרְפְּתָא. Sed Levit.11.19. in Jon. legitur pro eo טַרְפְּרָא.

עָרַץ Hebr. Violentia usus fuit, violenter exagitavit, confregit vel contrivit. Hinc Ch. ex Ithpeh. elifo ת. וְלֹא אִיעָרָצָא Nec violenter exagitata fuit, Numer.19.2. in Targ. Jon. Legitur ibi corruptè אִיעָרָצָא: sed aliter legendum monet Cōmentator Hebræus in hoc Targum. Deinde עָרַז Syr. Obvenire, obtingere, idem quod עָרַץ, 1.Pet.5.9.

עָרַק Ch.& Syr. Fugere, aufugere, perfugere, profugere. Pahel עָרַק Fugere facere, fugare. Aphel אַעֲרִיק Idem. Deinde ex alia signif. וַיְּרַתְּנָא מַעֲרִיק Et susurro divellit amicum suum, Prov.16.28. Alia exemplaria habent מַעֲרִיק: Regia מַפְרִיק.
עֲרוּקָא, עָרִיק Ch. Fugitivus, profugus. Plur. עֲרוּקֵי עֲרוּקִין.
מַעֲרְקָא Ch. Idem. Plur. מַעֲרְקִין, מַעֲרְקָיָא.

page.notes: Much of the Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee is printed with points and in forms that are hard to read exactly; the transcription of these words is approximate and marked as doubtful where uncertain. No marginal notes or engravings are present.
